reading: Mined add is a positional suffix rule: length-OOD (2p/4p) and distractor-noise hold (ROBUST 2/3, 3/3, 3/3); query-first collapses to ~0.2 (FRAGILE 0/3 — the model reads the LAST 4 tokens, not the query). Expectation LEN-FRAIL MISSED (robust); format-order is the fragile axis, not length. Same positional story as the whole program.
